scenes.title: Exploded super shoe
scenes.what: On a white crumpled-paper stage with a red running-track mat, the shoe explodes into 5 layers; lime dots with dotted leader lines and numbered labels 1–5; then torn-paper headline tags ('Tech Doping: a Serious Threat') pin around it.
scenes.motion: Layers separate vertically (ease-out), labels pop in order, paper tags slap on with a slight tilt
scenes.type: Lime numerals; italic serif headlines on orange/blue tags

scenes.title: Cold-open cut-out collage
scenes.what: Photo cut-outs of runners' shoes stack on the paper/track stage; then a grid of old sports gear → modern versions with lime down-arrows.
scenes.motion: Cut-outs drop in staggered with a hard shadow; arrows pop row by row

scenes.title: Blade prosthesis tease
scenes.what: Running blade on the track mat, lime arrows show ground force.

scenes.title: Shoe flash
scenes.what: Shoe close-up on a gradient plinth.

scenes.title: Shoe swarm
scenes.what: Dozens of cut-out shoes fly past camera in a vortex, small lime era tags.

scenes.title: HUGE* title
scenes.what: Standard house title: cropped letters, colourway swaps, asterisk pattern, '*if true', lime HUGE*.

scenes.title: Foam on fire
scenes.what: Shoe foam composited as a flaming lattice in a glass case beside the host.

scenes.title: A guide to banning stuff
scenes.what: Graph-paper stage; slanted italic title 'A GUIDE TO BANNING STUFF:' with blue outline and lime fill; a decision tree of glossy pill buttons (blue→pink 'IS IT DANGEROUS?', red YES/BANNED, lime NO/ALLOWED) grows; WADA rule cards with lime highlights and inset footage pop in beside it.
scenes.motion: Connector lines draw down, pills pop 115→100 in order, camera pans down the tree
scenes.type: Heavy italic caps title with outline; white caps on glossy gradient pills

scenes.title: Spirit of the sport
scenes.what: Camera follows the tree's NO branch to the next pill 'IS IT AGAINST THE "SPIRIT" OF THE SPORT?'.

scenes.title: Question stack
scenes.what: Pills stack in a list: CAN EVERYONE USE IT? / FAIR TO RECORDS? / DOES IT 'ARTIFICIALLY ENHANCE'?
scenes.motion: Pills pop in one by one, ~10f apart

scenes.title: Framed archive in the bleachers
scenes.what: Archival swim footage in a thick orange→lime gradient frame set on a 3D stadium stage (floodlights, bleachers, track); big lime year '1972'/'1976' top-right with dark outline; blue splat sticker bottom-left; becomes the '# OF RECORDS BROKEN' chart.
scenes.motion: Frame slides in, year swaps hard, VHS 'PAUSE' text

scenes.title: Records chart
scenes.what: Line chart on paper, blue→pink gradient line spikes; lime arrow points at the new spike; lime header pill.
scenes.motion: Line draws L→R then extends; arrow bob
scenes.type: Lime title pill; tiny axis numbers

scenes.title: Records chart reprise
scenes.what: Same chart redraw with the 2008 spike.

scenes.title: Arrow on footage
scenes.what: Lime block arrow points at a swimmer, 'PAUSE' VHS text.

scenes.title: Headline wall
scenes.what: Swimsuit-ban headlines on paper texture, lime highlighter on the key phrase; quotes; ends with a rule diagram of body coverage.
scenes.motion: Each headline pushes in ~0.4s; highlight wipes L→R

scenes.title: Rifle shooters in frames
scenes.what: Two framed clips side by side on the stadium stage; 'PRESCRIPTION GLASSES' pill → BANNED/ALLOWED; blue eye icon badge.

scenes.title: Sticky glue
scenes.what: Pill tree: STICKY GLUE → BANNED; connector highlights red then lime.

scenes.title: 'Too good?' super shoes
scenes.what: Shoe on the track stage; it splits into layers; italic serif 'SUPER SHOES', lime-highlighted 'Too Good?', 'Next gen shoe', 'Tech Doping' tags pop around.
scenes.type: Mixed italic serif + lime highlight tags

scenes.title: Foam on fire reprise
scenes.what: Flaming foam flash.

scenes.title: Circle the shoe
scenes.what: Marathon footage; a hand-drawn lime ellipse circles the pink shoe.

scenes.title: Slider comparison
scenes.what: Paper stage with horizontal gradient sliders (CHANGE IN RACE TIMES / CHANCE OF A PERSONAL BEST), lime knob for Vaporfly, blue knob 'NEXT FASTEST SHOE'; shoe sits bottom-right on a green hill; then a CNN headline drops in.
scenes.motion: Knobs slide along the bar to their value; labels fade

scenes.title: Shoe history
scenes.what: Shoe fades to ghost → collage of shoes by decade with lime outlined decade labels (1990's, 1950's) → 1860's spiked leather shoe with lime label and caption.
scenes.motion: Cut-outs burst in; camera pushes to the oldest

scenes.title: Circle the shoe #2
scenes.what: Same lime ellipse on footage.

scenes.title: Super-shoe headlines
scenes.what: Headline cards with lime highlight, push-in.

scenes.title: Midsole & energy return
scenes.what: Shoe layers float on blueprint-blue; 'MIDSOLE' lime label; '"ENERGY RETURN"' lime with quote marks; 'TALLER FOAM STACK' with a bracket.
scenes.motion: Layers separate; labels pop; bracket draws
scenes.type: Lime heavy caps with dark outline

scenes.title: 65% vs 80%+
scenes.what: Two shoes on the track; percentages count up (blue 65%, lime 80%+) with bell curves drawing under them.

scenes.title: Marathon record chart
scenes.what: Dot plot of runners who switched shoes (lime circle on 5%); line chart IMPROVEMENT IN MEN'S MARATHON WORLD RECORD with a lime end dot; Business Insider headline with highlight.
scenes.motion: Dots pop; line draws to lime end dot

scenes.title: OFF-AIR gag
scenes.what: Glitchy colour-bar test card with 'OFF-AIR' in white heavy caps.

scenes.title: The rule change
scenes.what: Pill 'FASTER SHOES?' YES/NO; shoe floats on blue with 'ONLY 1 CARBON FIBER PLATE' and '40mm HEIGHT LIMIT' lime labels with brackets; red 'PROTOTYPE' rubber stamp slams on; press-release text with lime highlights.
scenes.motion: Stamp scales from 140% → 100% with a shake; labels pop

scenes.title: Quote card
scenes.what: White quote card with blue left bar over desaturated footage; key phrase lime-highlighted; brand mark ghosted.

scenes.title: Remote interview on the stadium stage
scenes.what: Video-call panels in gradient frames side by side on the track stage, then single big frame; archival frame with '2012'; pill tree YES/NO.

scenes.title: Enhancement vs correction
scenes.what: Pill tree ENHANCEMENT/CORRECTION with a blade; 3D mannequin; blade on the track with lime force arrows; back to framed interview.

scenes.title: MASH acrostic
scenes.what: Research paper with lime highlight labels ('40% slower acceleration'); headline; framed interview; 'Max / Allowable / Standing / Height' acrostic with big lime initials.
scenes.motion: Labels pop; acrostic lines type in

scenes.title: Body proportions
scenes.what: Grey mannequin on graph paper with dimension brackets X/Y/Z, lime '5'8' height tag, two comparison figures and chart insets.

scenes.title: Wingspan = height
scenes.what: Swimmer cut-out with a double arrow 'WINGSPAN = HEIGHT'; figure with '6'7 WINGSPAN' and '6'4 HEIGHT' brackets.

scenes.title: Interview + glasses tree
scenes.what: Framed interview layouts; GLASSES BANNED/ALLOWED tree.

scenes.title: Two-up interview
scenes.what: Split interview frames on the track stage → single.

scenes.title: Interview frame
scenes.what: Single framed interview.

scenes.title: End card (sage + teal credits)
scenes.what: HUGE* on sage with 'SUBSCRIBE!' and arrow; credits on grey label plates on teal.
